title: User Scores Not Saving
description: Users lose their scores after completing the game.

title: Add Customization Options for Administrators
description: Administrators should be able to customize game settings and questions easily. Introduce options for more customization.

title: FAQ Section in Help Menu
description: Add a frequently asked questions section to the help menu to address common user concerns.

title: Math Umbrella Outdated
description: Links in the math umbrella are not up-to-date and produce 404 errors.

title: Improve Graphics for Sixth Graders
description: Sixth graders were not engaged by the graphics. Update visuals with elements exciting for younger audiences.

title: Incorrect Audio Feedback for Answers
description: No audio feedback when users select the correct/incorrect answer. Add sound effects for certain responses to improve user experience.

title: User Progress Tracking Missing
description: Users cannot track their progress while in the game. Implement a progress tracker.

title: Incorrect Answers Do Not Give Helpful Feedback
description: Incorrect answers display a generic message. Add specific explanations for wrong choices to aid learning.

title: Flash Movies Take Too Long to Load
description: Users on slower connections/devices experience long load times. Attempt to optimize assets or add a loading indicator.

title: Add a Hint Button
description: Add a hint option to questions to provide helpful information about questions to users.

title: Game Does Not Handle Small Sized Screens Well
description: Game fails to adjust properly to very small screens, displaying overlapping elements.

title: Questions Are Repeated
description: Identical questions are shown more than once per game sequence. Improve question randomization.

title: Error Handling in Question Updater
description: If invalid data is entered by an adminstrator, there is no clear error message. Improve validation and error messages.

title: Score Display Shows Incorrect Values
description: The final score does not always reflect the user's correct answers. Fix score calculation.

title: Skipping the Introductory Movie Causes Visual Errors
description: When skipped, some UI elements fail to load correctly. Fix scene transitions.

title: Replaying Game Does Not Reset User Score
description: Restarting the game does not reset the player's score.

title: Missing Hover Effects
description: Buttons do not change appearence when hovered over. Improve visual feedback for buttons.

title: Reloading Browser Breaks Game Sequence
description: If the user reloads the browser, the game fails to load correctly, resetting user progress. Implement a progress saving feature.

title: Robotic Sidekick UI Improvement
description: Make the robotic sidekick react based on correct/incorrect answers and the general storyline.

title: Introduce a Timer
description: Create the option for a timed mode where users time is recorded in addition to their score.

title: Accessibility Options
description: Introduce accessibility features such as text-to-speech, text/font size adjusters, or colorblind friendly color palettes.

title: Question Updater Not Secure
description: The question updater component fails to ask for a password consistently, introducing security concerns.

title: Add Descriptions for Math Umbrella Links
description: Math Umbrella links do not always have a helpful/relevant description for each project. For example, problems about adding fractions just show visual representations of the fractions.

title: Implement Search Function in Math Umbrella
description: Add a search bar in the math umbrella to allow users to quickly find S2S projects.

title: Program Interface is Confusing
description: The program interface is confusing and unintuitive, especially for younger users with little technology experience. Create a simpler menu.
